import RNA, itertools
target='......(......((((.....))))......)......................'
# The lonely pair (6,32) is hard. The hairpin wants to span 13-25.
# To force (6,32) to form, we need the structure between to actually pair 6 with 32.
# That means positions 7-31 must form an interior structure OR be unpaired.
# But target wants 7-12 unpaired, 13-16 paired to 22-25, 17-21 loop, 26-31 unpaired.
# So 6-32 is a true isolated/lonely pair (no stacking). Lonely pairs barely stabilize.
# Strategy: make 6-32 = G-C, and make SURE no alternative hairpin forms.
# Try strengthening the hairpin stem with all GC, and make 6,32 GC.
# Also try different loop sequences.
base='AAAAAAGAAAAAAGGGGGAAAACCCCAAAAAACAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA'
# all-GC stem, GC lonely pair
import random
best=None
for trial in range(500000):
    s=list(base)
    # hairpin stem positions 13-16 / 22-25: keep GGGG/CCCC but allow mixed
    s[13]=random.choice('GC'); s[14]=random.choice('GC'); s[15]=random.choice('GC'); s[16]=random.choice('GC')
    s[22]= {'G':'C','C':'G'}[s[13]]; s[23]= {'G':'C','C':'G'}[s[14]]; s[24]= {'G':'C','C':'G'}[s[15]]; s[25]= {'G':'C','C':'G'}[s[16]]
    s[17:22]=list(random.choice(['GAAAC','GAAA','GCAAC','GAGAC','GAAAU']))
    # lonely pair
    s[6]=random.choice('GC'); s[32]={'G':'C','C':'G'}[s[6]]
    s[5]=random.choice('ACGU'); s[7]=random.choice('ACGU')
    s[31]=random.choice('ACGU'); s[33]=random.choice('ACGU')
    s=''.join(s)
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(s)
    mfe,energy=fc.mfe()
    if mfe==target:
        print('SOLVED',s,energy)
        best=s
        break
print('found',best)
